$comment: Exact-phrase exceptions to the content guard (CLAUDE.md §9, §12). Every entry MUST carry a `reason` — the guard exits 1 on an entry without one. Ships EMPTY and should stay that way: the C9 disclaimer was reworded rather than excepted (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md C9), which is the better outcome. Adding an entry here means a banned term is shipping to visitors, so it needs the owner's agreement, not a developer's convenience.

$schema.phrase: Exact text that may contain a banned term. Case-insensitive. A violation is suppressed only when the match falls INSIDE an occurrence of this phrase — an allowance never disables a rule globally.
$schema.reason: Required. Why this phrase is acceptable and who agreed.
$schema.rule: Optional. Which rule id this relates to, for readers.
